metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Bell and the tables.

yesterday: You paid sixpence for the parcel and twopence for the letter. Eightpence went out of the purse.
Hobbins watered the horses before he turned a bag out.
The ruts are iron. He walked the last mile in. He has six horses. Gilbert goes on to St Bride's.
Edith's eight shillings is still on the tables, owed till Lady Day.
The throat is worse than it was on Tuesday.
